finding.preliminary_assessment: VULN-021 and VULN-023 correctly apply Math.max/Math.min clamping to prevent out-of-range substring bounds, but the clamping logic uses optional chaining (field.content?.length ?? 0) for the guard while the downstream substring() calls use direct property access (f1.content.substring()). If field.content is null or undefined (possible when server sends a field with no content property), contentLen correctly defaults to 0 but the subsequent .substring() call throws TypeError: Cannot read property 'substring' of null. This crash denies the entire screen rendering for the session. A compromised ApplinX backend sending a transformation rectangle for a field with null content would crash the ScreenProcessorService, causing a DoS. Additionally, filterCollisions() has an unbounded array growth issue (VULN-012) and processTable() lacks row bounds validation.

patterns_observed: VULN-021 and VULN-023 clamping logic is semantically correct for non-null content

Rectangle constructor accepts coordinates without any bounds validation
filterCollisions() grows array during iteration — O(n) growth per server-sent overlapping rect
processTable() computes body.bottomRight.row from rows.length without bounds check
